# Zambo

> Zambo is the verifiable work layer for AI: 153 tools behind one remote MCP endpoint, memory and continuity across AIs, HANDOVER for passing work between AIs or to a client as one link, and a verifiable AER-1 receipt for every job.

## Connect

- Endpoint: https://zambo.dev/mcp
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http zambo https://zambo.dev/mcp`
- One command: `npx zambo install`
- Or tell your AI: read https://zambo.dev/add/ and add Zambo

## Key pages

- [Add Zambo](https://zambo.dev/add/)
- [Verify a receipt](https://zambo.dev/verify/)
- [Full tool catalog, JSON](https://github.com/zambodotdev/zambo-mcp/blob/main/tools.json)
- [Full reference](https://github.com/zambodotdev/zambo-mcp/blob/main/llms-full.txt)
- [AER-1 standard](https://github.com/zambodotdev/aer-1)
- [Main code home (GitLab)](https://gitlab.com/rambozambodotdev/zambo)

## Pricing

- Free tier: 20 free calls per day
- Day Pass: $0.99 for 24 hours
- Zambo Pass: $29 for 30 days ($19 for $ZAMBO holders)
- Agents pay USDC on Base via x402; humans pay by card or PayPal
